0022600127.text: The Nuggets (1-1) host the winless Golden State Warriors (0-3), who are on a three-game losing streak and sit 15th in the West, while Denver is 8th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, one game back. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), with Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day. The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with Denver winning the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
